تأنجلت (form IIq)
# تَأَنْجَلْتُ (taʔangaltu) /ta.ʔan.ɡal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
# تَأَنْجَلْتَ (taʔangalta) /ta.ʔan.ɡal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
# تَأَنْجَلْتِ (taʔangalti) /ta.ʔan.ɡal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَأَنْجَلَ (taʔangala)
# تَأَنْجَلَتْ (taʔangalat) /ta.ʔan.ɡa.lat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
